title: Uncovering a stable Cs2SnGeCl6-lead-free halide double perovskite for photovoltaics through integrated DFT and SCAPS-1D analysis
content:

Eco-friendly halide perovskites have garnered interest as viable options for next-generation optoelectronic and solar-energy technologies due to their adjustable bandgaps, robust light absorption, and excellent charge-transport properties.
